purpose: Defines the fields, preconditions, and structure of the 'Radiologist Review Queue' screen within workflow WF_001.
preconditions: Image acquisition has been marked complete
postconditions: All required fields on 'Radiologist Review Queue' are captured and saved before advancing to the next screen.
validations: Confirm the study has been assigned to a radiologist before entering the queue
Confirm STAT-priority studies are flagged at the top of the queue
Confirm prior comparable studies are linked for comparison where available
common_errors: STAT study not flagged as priority in the queue
Study assigned to an inactive radiologist account
